items.text: Millions of women receive a breast cancer diagnosis annually. As a member of the Cancer Prevention Caucus & someone whose family has been touched by cancer, I'm proud to support our scientists & medical professionals fighting this devastating disease. #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth

On the 17th day of our #25DaysofSuccesses, I secured $1,755,303 for Sewer Separation to support the St. Clair Shores Martin Drain. Sewer separation is a matter of basic public health and hygiene, and I'm glad to have helped get the necessary funding to make that happen.

The chaotic border crisis is completely out of control under Biden's failed leadership.

Energy and Commerce also oversees health and health care issues.

#MI10 is home to 8 hospitals, 145 different health care providers, and over 2,700 businesses in the health care sector which supports a workforce of 43,105 people.

The Biden Admin just announced new cuts to Medicare Advantage. About 26 million seniors are enrolled in these plans and will now have to pay more for their health care as a result of the Biden Admin's cuts.

We must hold Biden accountable for failing our seniors.

Joe Biden is gaslighting the American people, once again. He lies by accusing Republicans of trying to cut Medicare, hoping that Americans won’t notice that his administration JUST cut Medicare Advantage plans. Because of this, health care costs will skyrocket for our Seniors.

This week, I introduced the Protecting America’s Working Dogs (PAW) Act to Congress with @RepSusanWild. This bill would boost financial coverage of veterinary costs for service dogs after they and their service member owners retire from our military. 🐶🇺🇸

Today, I passed my first @HouseCommerce bill through markup--the TELEMH Act! And it was even more special to have my son, John John, with me during the markup!

This legislation would revolutionize access to mental health care via telehealth. A big win for access to health care! https://t.co/TNx6PsgKN1

This week, @HouseCommerce passed my bill, the TELEMH Act, out of committee.

This bill will expand critical access to mental health services via telehealth & address the hopelessness crisis in America.

A special s/o to @RepDavid and @RepDonDavis, who were original cosponsors.

Biden's apparent declining health is a national security threat.

That’s why I introduced my D.C. Accountability Package to create age and term limits for our elected leaders. The world isn't getting slower, it's getting faster.

Americans deserve affordable access to quality healthcare. This shouldn't be a partisan issue.

I was proud to support the Lower Costs, More Transparency Act--which will help cut the cost of drug prices and medical fees, while providing much needed transparency for patients.

Our nurses, firefighters, and healthcare workers in Southeast Michigan are some of our community's best. That's why I'm fighting for them.

My legislation, the Reignite Hope Act, would give these local heroes a tax credit for their heroic service to our district.

I was honored to bring home $1.5M to benefit our seniors at the Shelby Rec. Center!

Upholding the health & wellness of our seniors is non-negotiable. It's why I introduced the Protecting Social Security & Medicare Act, & it's why I will never stop fighting for our seniors! https://t.co/omSXUs7sfb

As a vet who has been to war, I know the transition to civilian life shouldn't be the hardest battle we face.

That's why I introduced my Veterans' Entry to Apprenticeship Act, and cosponsored bills like the Vet CENTERS for Mental Health Act and the Veterans Patient Advocacy Act.

As a veteran of Operation Iraqi Freedom, I know there is so much more we can do to help out our heroes that served. 

That's why I cosponsored the Vet CENTERS for Mental Health Act to ensure that there are an adequate number of Vet Centers in each state.

This week, I walked to raise awareness for firefighter cancer. Cancer impacts too many lives and I'm fighting to end that.

It's why I led a resolution to designate a "National Cancer Prevention Day" and legislation to allow for Medicare coverage of early cancer detection tests.
